question: Why does Costco end its fiscal year on the Sunday nearest the end of August?
settings: model openrouter:openai/gpt-oss-20b, temperature 0.6, reasoning effort low, max_tokens 700; retriever hybrid, k 8, question text only, no filters
answer: Costco explains that its 52‑ or 53‑week fiscal year is structured to end on the Sunday nearest the end of August so that the fourth quarter of the year captures the company’s peak seasonal period—the winter holiday season—when sales and earnings are highest. The filing notes that the “material seasonal impact in our operations is increased net sales and earnings during the winter holiday season” and that the fiscal year is arranged to align the quarter‑end with that period.
